text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. Although this takes extra time at the beginning, it saves time later by catching problems early. Good tests give developers confidence to change and improve their code without fear of breaking things. In the end, testing is not just about finding bugs; it is about building reliable software that people can trust.
